scope: Seasonal landscape, tree lifecycle, card palettes and draggable season progress; no inference changes

lifecycle.autumn: fruit, cloudy wind and falling leaves
lifecycle.winter: bare branches, snowfall and accumulated snow

controls: Drag to hold any seasonal phase; play resumes the ten-minute cycle from that phase. Keyboard adjustment and persisted position supported.
transitions: One fixed landscape, smoothly blended weather, tree lifecycle and opaque card colors; Geometry and Nature remain separate themes.

frame_timing.context: Local headless Chromium requestAnimationFrame measurements; not a hardware performance guarantee. Renderer normally throttled to 20 fps.
